purpose: Test whether strictly-prior exact-NFT sale history can be learned as a time-sensitive input to inactive secondary-resale valuation

population.training: Every completed historical sale strictly before each target cutoff; no filtering by target price, realized venue, or prediction availability
population.evaluation: Every event in the frozen 2024Q4 and 2025-01 exposed evaluation blocks; all cases retained
population.realizedVenue: Retrospective reporting only; never a feature or routing condition

ownHistoryFeatures.identity: Exact nftAddress and a single unambiguous normalized username in all strictly-prior finalized sale records
ownHistoryFeatures.strictTimeCutoff: sale.eventTime < target.eventTime; simultaneous and future sales excluded
ownHistoryFeatures.priceRole: A learned input to the regression, not a minimum bound or permanent floor
ownHistoryFeatures.otherInputs: Frozen 118 point-in-time structural/semantic features and 128 fixed SHA-256 spelling indicators; existing static-control tabular features are unchanged

candidate.family: all-stage sklearn HistGradientBoostingRegressor on log historical USD with four strictly-prior own-history features
candidate.missingOwnHistory: Native missing values; no target rows removed
candidate.calibration: For each estimator, expand fitted 10th/90th log-price bounds using finite-sample 80% conformal score on strictly later secondary calibration outcomes; same calibration rows and formula for the matched static control

controls: Matched all-stage HGB with the existing 246 features and same fixed parameters, fit/calibrated on the same temporal fold
Strictly-prior last-own-sale value, diagnostic only and reported on common own-history availability
Full same-case v25 replay is mandatory before any candidate promotion; saved overlapping point reports are not an adequate substitute

reporting.uncertainty: Deterministic identity-clustered 2000-resample paired 95% interval for premium MALE improvement

promotionGates.currentMarketProspectiveValidation: Required separately; these exposed temporal blocks cannot qualify production

limitations: Both evaluation blocks are exposed development data; 2024Q4 is reused as calibration in the second fold and neither is untouched qualification.
The earlier-own-price diagnostic is descriptive and outcome-stratified; it does not establish a causal improvement or a production rule.
Historical USD comes from the frozen research export, whose indexed sources have mixed settlement provenance.
No production integration is authorized by a development pass alone.
